from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    border = [g[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if i in (0,h-1) or j in (0,w-1)]
    bg = Counter(border).most_common(1)[0][0]
    zeros = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x == 0]
    colored = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x != bg and x != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(i for i,j in colored), max(i for i,j in colored)
    c0, c1 = min(j for i,j in colored), max(j for i,j in colored)
    tr, tc = min(i for i,j in zeros), min(j for i,j in zeros)
    for i in range(r1-r0+1):
        for j in range(c1-c0+1):
            g[tr+i][tc+j] = g[r0+i][c1-j]
    return g
